rules.title: Rules
rules.intro: Two independent championships. Sixteen participants per category. The audience decides, one match at a time, who reaches the final.
rules.flowEyebrow: From the first match to the final
rules.flowText: Photography and music use the same bracket structure, with separate entries, votes and winners. Each category runs one match at a time.
rules.secretNote: Votes stay secret during a match. Counts become public only after that match has finished.
rules.ctaTitle: The next entry could be yours.
rules.ctaText: Submit a photograph or a song with its cover.
rules.accepted: By participating in Unseen you confirm that you have read and accepted these rules.

articles.title: Two separate championships
articles.intro: UNSEEN runs independent photography and music championships. Participation is free. You must sign in to submit an entry or vote.

rules.label: Files
rules.text: Use JPG, PNG or WEBP, up to 5 MB. Images are optimized for publication.

rules.label: Details
rules.text: Provide the title and author. You may add a description and your Instagram username, linking directly to your profile.

rules.label: Authorship
rules.text: Submit your own photograph and hold the necessary rights. Offensive material and content that violates privacy or others? rights are not allowed.

rules.label: Audio and cover
rules.text: Choose an MP3 or WAV file up to 30 MB and a JPG, PNG or WEBP cover up to 5 MB. The cover accompanies the record in the music arena.

rules.label: Competition excerpt
rules.text: Select exact start and end points in the form, with a maximum of 40 seconds. Preview it before submitting. Only the chosen excerpt is uploaded for the competition.

rules.label: Optional profile and links
rules.text: Provide title and artist. You may add Instagram and links to your song on YouTube, as an Instagram Reel or on Spotify. Links do not replace the required audio and cover.

rules.label: Rights
rules.text: You must be the song?s author and hold the necessary rights to the cover too. Do not submit material that infringes others? rights.

rules.label: Review first
rules.text: The team reviews submissions. Submission or approval does not guarantee a place in the next championship.

rules.label: Sixteen different authors
rules.text: Administrators select 16 approved entries per category, with one entry per participant in each championship. The previous limit of one photograph per month no longer applies.

rules.label: Seeds and pairings
rules.text: Initial seeds #1?#16 are assigned before the start: #1 faces #2, #3 faces #4, and so on. The scheduled bracket is visible in Championship.

rules.label: Repeated uploads
rules.text: Each account can start up to 5 upload attempts per 24 hours, shared between photographs and songs. An upload started but not completed may still count. The form tells you when the limit is reached.

rules.label: Starting date
rules.text: Administrators choose the start date and time. There are no fixed stages starting on the 1st or 15th of each month.

rules.label: One match every 48 hours
rules.text: 8 round-of-16 matches, 4 quarterfinals, 2 semifinals and 1 final run sequentially. Each lasts 48 hours. The championship ends after exactly 720 hours, or 30 days, including across daylight-saving changes.

rules.label: Automatic advancement
rules.text: After each match the system determines the winner and fills the next round without changing the schedule.

rules.label: Cancelled championships
rules.text: A championship cancelled by administrators stops, retains its history and does not publish a gallery champion.

rules.label: Sign-in and one vote
rules.text: You must sign in and vote within the match?s 48-hour window. Each account has one vote per match; a recorded vote cannot be changed.

rules.label: Results at the end
rules.text: The audience cannot see live totals. Scores appear in the bracket when the result is finalized. Administrators can inspect counts and the vote register during the competition.

rules.label: Who advances
rules.text: The entry with more votes advances automatically. Votes from earlier matches do not carry over.

rules.label: Ties, including zero votes
rules.text: The participant with the better initial seed, the lower number, advances. The same seed applies in every round: for example #3 outranks #12. This also applies when both entries receive zero votes.

rules.label: Follow the competition
rules.text: Championship shows entries, pairings, schedule and finalized results. Winners fill the next blocks; eliminated entries are darkened and marked with an X.

rules.label: One champion per category
rules.text: The final winner is that championship?s champion. It automatically enters the gallery with its photograph, or cover and song.

rules.label: The winner?s month
rules.text: The champion belongs to the championship?s starting month in Europe/Rome time. A competition starting in October and ending in November has an October winner.

rules.label: Archive
rules.text: Previous collections remain available. Historical awards and the Arena of Champions are not stages of the new championship.

articles.title: Fair play and anti-bot
articles.intro: Only registered users may vote, with one vote per duel. Bots, fake or duplicate accounts, automated scripts and artificial vote exchanges are forbidden; suspicious votes may be cancelled.

articles.title: Copyright and usage licence
articles.intro: The author keeps full copyright. By uploading a photo, the author grants Unseen a free, non-exclusive licence to display and promote it with credit, without any sale or transfer to third parties without written permission.
